description: This file contains tests for the tenantClient utility functions in a JavaScript frontend project, utilizing Jest for testing. It tests functions such as normalizeTenantId, fetchSessionTenants, selectTenant, and setActiveTenant, focusing on their behavior, mocking fetch API and localStorage interactions.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various shapes of tenant identifier inputs into a string ID or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenants from the server session endpoint, returning an array of tenant objects.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant, posts to server, updates local storage, and sets the active tenant.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant in localStorage, replacing any legacy key.

methods.name: getActiveTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the current active tenant from localStorage.
